Milk is drunk in the middle house (House 3). The green house is immediately to the left of the white house, and coffee is drunk in the green house. What color is House 2?

On an island of Knights (who always tell the truth) and Knaves (who always lie), you meet two inhabitants, Alex and Blair. Alex says: 'At least one of us is a Knave.' Blair says nothing. What are Alex and Blair?

choices.B: Alex is a Knave and Blair is a Knight
choices.C: Alex is a Knight and Blair is a Knave

prompt: Four runners—Alice, Bob, Charlie, and David—finished a race with no ties. Charlie finished ahead of Alice. Bob did not finish last. David finished immediately after Charlie. Alice finished ahead of Bob. What was the exact finishing order from 1st to 4th?

Three boxes are labeled 'Apples', 'Oranges', and 'Apples and Oranges'. Every single box is known to be incorrectly labeled. You are allowed to draw exactly one fruit from exactly one box without looking inside. From which box must you draw to determine the true contents of all three boxes?

choices.D: It is mathematically impossible with only one draw

prompt: Consider three prisoners: P1, P2, and P3, standing in a line all facing forward such that P3 can see P2 and P1, P2 can see P1, and P1 can see no one. There are 3 black hats and 2 white hats. The warden places a hat on each prisoner and hides the remaining two. The warden asks P3 if he knows his hat color; P3 says 'No'. Then P2 is asked; P2 says 'No'. What can P1 deduce with absolute certainty about his own hat color?

choices.A: P1 must be wearing a white hat
choices.B: P1 must be wearing a black hat
choices.C: P1 could be wearing either color with equal probability
choices.D: P1 cannot deduce his hat color without knowing P2's color
